title: Freelance GPU Infrastructure / MLOps Engineer (Remote, Contract)
description:
We are an Australian GPU cloud provider building a small bench of freelance engineers to deploy and support customer GPU environments. Work includes project-based setups and ongoing support with capped hours. We are seeking long-term partners.

Our infrastructure includes on-demand GPU instances, dedicated 8-GPU nodes and enterprise clusters with H100, H200, B200 and B300 GPUs. Customer workloads include AI training and inference. Infrastructure is in Australia, with partner capacity in the UK, Europe and the US.

Responsibilities
- Set up Ubuntu GPU servers with NVIDIA drivers, CUDA, Docker and NVIDIA Container Toolkit.
- Deploy model inference services such as vLLM, TGI or Triton behind HTTPS.
- Configure Prometheus, Grafana and DCGM Exporter monitoring and downtime alerts.
- Resolve customer access issues, GPU errors, service restarts and patching tickets.
- Turn working deployments into reusable Ansible, Terraform or script templates.
- On larger projects, support multi-node training with Slurm or Kubernetes, NCCL and InfiniBand.

Required experience
- Strong Ubuntu/Linux administration and production NVIDIA GPU troubleshooting, including driver/CUDA compatibility, nvidia-smi, DCGM and Xid errors.
- Docker GPU workloads, ML inference deployments, monitoring and alerting.
- Clear written English for direct customer communication.

Experience with PyTorch DDP/FSDP, DeepSpeed, Slurm, Kubernetes GPU Operator, InfiniBand/RoCE, or GPU cloud/HPC operations is useful.

Remote contract, hourly or per project. European and Asia-Pacific time zones are especially welcome. NDA, non-solicitation and IP assignment will be required.

Shortlisted candidates will be offered a paid 2–3 hour test through Upwork: deploy a vLLM inference service with Grafana monitoring and downtime alerts on a GPU instance we provide.

Please apply through Upwork with: (1) specific GPU/ML infrastructure projects, GPU types and scale; (2) time zone and weekly availability; (3) hourly rate in USD; and (4) brief examples of relevant work. Keep all pre-contract communication and payment on Upwork.
